extension.name: MarantzHTTP
extension.description: Control two Marantz and Denon receivers independently via HTTP with bidirectional volume sync, tabbed dual-receiver settings UI, sound mode selection (Stereo, Direct, Multi Ch Stereo, etc.), Dirac Live and Audyssey room calibration preset selection (Speaker Preset 1/2, Dirac Slots 1-3, MultEQ) on startup, receiver capability detection, automatic power-on on playlist start, auto playlist playback on receiver power-on with standard and Dynamic Playlists (v4.7.1) support, track shuffle, empty queue guard, input selection, non-blocking asynchronous requests, and fail-safe auto-pause/auto-resume.
extension.creator: CypherMK
